title: NZBGet
wrapper_note:
the upstream image boots with the s6-overlay v3 init, whose service manager
runs as root; with user "1000:1000" nothing starts and port 6789 stays closed.
src/entrypoint.sh performs the same first-run setup as the image's init
(copy the default nzbget.conf, drop a stale lock) and runs the same binary the
s6 service runs, directly as the unprivileged container user. It also removes the
credentials the image ships in its template (ControlPassword=tegbzn6789 and the
dummy news server user/pass), generates a random control password on first start
and keeps nzbget.conf at mode 0600.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper** (not a privilege shim): the s6 service manager of the image needs root, so `src/entrypoint.sh` seeds the default `nzbget.conf`, removes the credentials shipped in the image's template, generates a random control password and starts NZBGet directly as the unprivileged container user.
user_mode_text: 上游镜像以 s6 管理服务且需要 root，入口包装改为直接以 uid 1000 运行 NZBGet，并生成随机网页登录密码
user_mode_cons:
- 上游镜像用 s6-overlay v3 管理服务，`user: "1000:1000"` 时 s6 无法启动 nzbget，
  容器 Up 但 6789 无人监听。因此 `src/entrypoint.sh` 复刻镜像 init 的首次初始化，
  再以容器用户执行镜像自带的 `/app/nzbget/nzbget`。
- 镜像模板里的 `ControlPassword=tegbzn6789` 与占位新闻服务器 `user`/`pass` 属于硬编码凭据，
  入口包装会清除它们并在首次启动时生成随机控制密码。
- NZBGet 自身不需要 root：配置、队列、日志都在 /config 卷内，实测非 root 下网页正常。
healthcheck_note: 探测首页 `/`，NZBGet 能应答即健康（首次启动生成 nzbget.conf，60s 宽限）。
descript: NZBGet is a lightweight Usenet downloader. It fetches NZBs from your news server over NNTP, verifies and repairs them with PAR2, unpacks the result and keeps a queue you manage from a web UI on port 8017. The package runs the LinuxServer.io image as a non-root container and keeps configuration, queue and downloads in the application data folder. Feeds, notifications and post-processing scripts work only when you configure them.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The first start generates a random web login for user nzbget and prints it in the container log (docker logs nzbgetdocker). Add your Usenet provider under Settings -> News Servers. Configuration, queue and downloads stay in the application data folder. Uninstall and delete DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker to erase everything.
release_note: 26.3-6: remediation of the App Center review (C3/C4/C5/C6/C8/C9/T1/T2). Added PRIVACY.md with retention, user rights, security measures, third-party sharing and the deletion channel, and NOTICE.md with the verified GPL-2.0 licence, image digests and trademarks. The help field now opens PRIVACY.md. Every outbound endpoint is disclosed (Usenet provider, RSS feeds, GitHub extension catalogue, SMTP, user scripts, Docker Hub) and no telemetry or update check exists. Description rewritten in all languages, including zh-cn and zh-hk, without the ASCII semicolons that truncated the store text. Security: the image's shipped default control password and dummy news-server credentials are removed, a random control password is generated at first start, nzbget.conf is 0600 in a 0700 directory, and all capabilities are dropped. T1: image upgraded from 26.3.20261106 (Alpine 3.24.3) to 26.3.20261120 (Alpine 3.24.4, LinuxServer v26.3-ls273). Port unchanged (8017).
data_notes: `config/` holds `nzbget.conf` (news servers, control login, feeds, notifications; mode 0600), the queue database, `nzb/`, `tmp/`, `scripts/` and the rotated `nzbget-YYYY-MM-DD.log` files (3 days); `downloads/completed/` receives the finished files and `downloads/intermediate/` holds unpack work. Copying the `nzbgetdocker` folder while the app is stopped is a complete backup (it contains credentials).
design_notes: **Non-root by construction.** The s6 service manager of the image needs root, so the wrapper seeds the default config and starts the NZBGet binary directly as `1000:1000`; all capabilities are dropped and `no-new-privileges` is set.

**No shipped credentials.** The template's `ControlPassword=tegbzn6789` and dummy news server are removed; a random 32-hex control password is generated on first start and `nzbget.conf` stays 0600 in a 0700 directory.
**Fixed multi-arch image tag `26.3.20261120`** (NZBGet publishes dated builds; index digest in `NOTICE.md`), Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no `cap_add`, no Docker socket.
**Health check** on the UI (`GET /` on port 6789) with a 60 s start period.
limitations: A fresh install has no active news server: the placeholder is removed, so nothing is contacted before you configure it. NZBGet logs `At least one server must be active` until you add your provider under Settings -> News Servers.
The web login is generated per install and printed once in the container log; the password is stored in `nzbget.conf` (`ControlPassword`) if you need to read it again.

TOS Docker applications cannot mount shared folders: downloads stay in `/Volume1/DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker/downloads/`. Move them out with File Manager, or edit `/Volume1/@apps/DockerEngine/application/nzbgetdocker/docker-compose.yml` after installation.
The UI is served over plain HTTP on the LAN. Do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.

zh-cn.descript: NZBGet 是轻量的 Usenet 下载器：从你配置的新闻服务器通过 NNTP 下载 NZB，用 PAR2 校验修复并自动解压，网页队列可在 8017 端口管理。本应用以非 root 容器运行 LinuxServer.io 镜像，配置、队列与下载保存在应用数据目录。RSS 订阅、邮件通知与后处理脚本仅在你自行配置后才会工作。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时自动安装）。首次启动会为用户 nzbget 生成随机网页登录密码并打印在容器日志中（docker logs nzbgetdocker）。请在「设置 → 新闻服务器」填写你的 Usenet 服务商。配置、队列与下载都保存在应用数据目录。卸载并删除 DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker 即可清除全部数据。
zh-cn.release_note: 26.3-6：按应用中心审核意见整改（C3/C4/C5/C6/C8/C9/T1/T2）。新增 PRIVACY.md（保留期、用户权利、安全措施、第三方共享、删除渠道）与 NOTICE.md（核实 GPL-2.0、镜像 digest、商标声明），help 字段改为打开 PRIVACY.md。隐私政策逐项披露对外连接（Usenet 服务商、RSS 订阅、GitHub 扩展目录、SMTP、用户脚本、Docker Hub），并说明没有遥测与更新检查。所有语言（含 zh-cn/zh-hk）重写描述，去掉会被商店解析成注释的 ASCII 分号。安全：移除镜像自带的默认控制密码与占位新闻服务器凭据，首次启动生成随机控制密码，nzbget.conf 为 0600、目录 0700，容器丢弃全部 capabilities。T1：镜像由 26.3.20261106（Alpine 3.24.3）升级到 26.3.20261120（Alpine 3.24.4，LinuxServer v26.3-ls273）。端口不变（8017）。

zh-hk.descript: NZBGet 是輕量的 Usenet 下載器：從你設定的新聞伺服器透過 NNTP 下載 NZB，用 PAR2 校驗修復並自動解壓，網頁佇列可在 8017 埠管理。本應用以非 root 容器執行 LinuxServer.io 映像，設定、佇列與下載保存在應用資料目錄。RSS 訂閱、郵件通知與後處理腳本僅在你自行設定後才會運作。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時自動安裝）。首次啟動會為使用者 nzbget 產生隨機網頁登入密碼並列印在容器日誌中（docker logs nzbgetdocker）。請在「設定 → 新聞伺服器」填寫你的 Usenet 服務商。設定、佇列與下載都保存在應用資料目錄。解除安裝並刪除 DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker 即可清除全部資料。
zh-hk.release_note: 26.3-6：按應用中心審核意見整改（C3/C4/C5/C6/C8/C9/T1/T2）。新增 PRIVACY.md（保留期、使用者權利、安全措施、第三方共享、刪除管道）與 NOTICE.md（核實 GPL-2.0、映像 digest、商標聲明），help 欄位改為開啟 PRIVACY.md。隱私政策逐項披露對外連線（Usenet 服務商、RSS 訂閱、GitHub 擴充目錄、SMTP、使用者腳本、Docker Hub），並說明沒有遙測與更新檢查。所有語言（含 zh-cn/zh-hk）重寫描述，去掉會被商店解析成註解的 ASCII 分號。安全：移除映像內建的預設控制密碼與佔位新聞伺服器憑證，首次啟動產生隨機控制密碼，nzbget.conf 為 0600、目錄 0700，容器丟棄全部 capabilities。T1：映像由 26.3.20261106（Alpine 3.24.3）升級到 26.3.20261120（Alpine 3.24.4，LinuxServer v26.3-ls273）。埠不變（8017）。
